_comment: Curated regulatory registry (QCO / CRS / mandatory certification). 'verification_state' is shown in the UI: 'source_checked' = date & coverage checked against a public source during curation; 'secondary_source' = checked against a reputable secondary summary (consultancy / certification body) but not the gazette itself; 'curated_unverified' = coverage believed correct but dates/notification numbers must be confirmed on bis.gov.in / e-Gazette before relying on them. Effective dates left null are treated as 'in force, date unverified'.
